answer: New identities are cheap, so a sybil attacker can flood the network like a river breaching its banks; tie each agent to a small liability cluster whose members share rewards and share slashing when one of them cheats, so the group polices itself. If a raven in the cluster steals the shared nectar, everyone pays, so honest members watch each other. The failure mode is a whole cluster colluding, so the check is random cross-cluster audits: publish membership and every slashing event, and let independent auditors sample clusters and flag any group whose members only ever vouch for each other.
